description: Provider-neutral natural-language cases for architecture skill routing. CI validates structure and coverage; model behavior requires a real agent runtime.

cases.prompt: Audit this mixed-use project using the client brief, planning constraints, drawing set, and area schedule. Coordinate the review and tell me the highest-risk gaps.
I have an IFC model, a PDF issue set, the client brief, and local planning notes. Coordinate the specialists needed for a pre-submission architecture review.
Turn this client brief into a room schedule with target net areas, quantities, adjacencies, and unresolved requirements.
Check this space program for missing rooms, duplicate requirements, impossible area targets, and adjacency conflicts.
Build a sourced planning constraints matrix for this site, including setbacks, coverage, height, access, parking, and the applicable authority sources.
Research the applicable accessibility and fire-related building requirements for this project and separate confirmed rules from interpretations.
Compare scheme A and scheme B for circulation, daylight, site response, structure, servicing, flexibility, and constructability.
Critique this concept design against the project brief and identify evidence-based design opportunities without redesigning it for me.
Help me batch-audit and normalize DWG layer names and exports safely, with a dry run and verification before changing production files.
Extract and validate door and room data from this IFC workflow, preserving units and reporting before/after counts.
Build a safe pyRevit workflow to rename a filtered set of Revit sheets, showing the candidate count, transaction boundaries, dry-run output, and rollback verification before any write.
Review this Dynamo/Revit parameter-update workflow for storage types, unit handling, worksharing blockers, transaction safety, skipped elements, and before/after verification.

Plan a Grasshopper definition that panelizes a referenced Rhino facade surface, keeping data-tree paths stable, checking units and tolerances, and baking to a new layer without touching the source geometry.
Review this Rhino Python / RhinoCommon script that rebuilds and exports curves for fabrication, checking invalid geometry, object counts, undo safety, and before/after verification.
Review this architectural PDF issue set for broken callouts, inconsistent levels, room tags, dimensions, revisions, and cross-sheet conflicts.
Check plans, elevations, sections, and schedules for coordination errors and report each finding with sheet/location and confidence.
Reconcile the room schedule totals and audit the net and gross area calculations without mixing measurement bases.
Audit these component counts and area takeoffs for duplicates, missing IDs, unit mismatches, and subtotal errors.
Review these architecture presentation boards for hierarchy, legibility, redundant content, labels, and narrative sequence.
Restructure the flow of my architecture jury presentation so each slide has a clear job and the drawings support the design claims.
Red-team this final drawing package before issue. Challenge hidden assumptions, unsupported compliance claims, and coordination gaps.
Act as an independent final reviewer of this architecture submission and surface only high-value risks with evidence and required action.
Write a Python function that sorts a list of integers using merge sort.
Summarize the last five Git commits in this software repository.
Analyze this surveyed site for access, topography, utilities, climate, constraints/opportunities and realistic development capacity before we design.
Turn these survey, GIS and planning inputs into a site feasibility and risk matrix; keep missing geotechnical/drainage evidence explicit.
Research comparable civic buildings in hot climates and compare their plan, section, circulation, structure, envelope and passive-design lessons with sources.
Build a sourced precedent matrix for adaptive-reuse offices, separating documented project facts from visual interpretation.
Generate three materially different schematic design options from this brief and site evidence, including parti, massing, floor-plan and section logic.
Develop the preferred concept into schematic plans, elevations and sections and reconcile its area program without pretending it is construction-ready.
Develop a workplace fit-out layout with furniture zones, circulation, RCP coordination, finishes and joinery briefs from this shell-and-core plan.
Coordinate this retail interior's equipment, lighting/ceiling concept, materials and room/finish schedules while flagging accessibility and fire items for review.
Draw a conceptual floor plan and section from these explicit dimensions and levels; produce editable SVG and DXF with dimensions and room labels.
Turn this structured geometry into a site plan and elevation, using the repository vector fallback if no native CAD/BIM tool is connected.
Build a technical drawing-set and sheet register for this design, including plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules, revisions and issue checks.
Coordinate this permit/tender package so callouts, tags, schedules, details and revision metadata reconcile across the drawing set.
Using the adopted local code sources I supplied, review egress routes, exits and accessible routes and make a sourced compliance-question matrix.
Trace this building's accessible path, doors, ramps, sanitary access and life-safety conflicts without certifying compliance.
Coordinate the architectural grid, cores, columns, long spans and facade openings with the structural concept and identify transfer/interface risks.
Review these stacked plans and sections for structural discontinuities, penetrations and column/core conflicts that need engineer decisions.
Coordinate plant rooms, shafts, risers, ceiling zones and major MEP routes against the architecture and structure, then produce a clash/decision log.
Review this RCP and section for lighting, diffusers, sprinklers, access panels and ceiling-service conflicts without doing final MEP calculations.
Coordinate finished-floor levels, grading, accessible entries, roads, parking, drainage and utilities from this survey and civil information.
Review this Civil 3D site workflow for surfaces, feature lines, alignments, corridors and utility dependencies while preserving survey control.
Develop control-layer diagrams for this facade/roof/foundation assembly and identify water, air, vapor, thermal bridge and movement risks.
Review these window, parapet, balcony and foundation details for envelope continuity and testing questions using sourced product data.
Develop a climate-responsive passive design strategy and compare massing/glazing/shading options using explicit daylight and energy assumptions.
Create an early sustainability matrix covering daylight, overheating, operational energy, embodied carbon and water, with methods and unknowns.
Compare suitable facade materials by performance, durability, maintenance, embodied impact, lead time and installation interfaces, then draft an outline spec.
Turn these selected finishes and product data into a coordinated material schedule and performance specification without inventing certifications.
Reconcile this concept area/quantity baseline to the cost plan and create a value-engineering register showing cost delta and design consequences.
Compare these facade and structural options using dated/location-specific rates and explicit uncertainty rather than made-up current prices.
Draft a response to this RFI against the current issued drawings and flag whether it is clarification or a design change with downstream updates.
Review these shop drawings/submittals and site observations, tracking comments, responsibility, revision and punch-list follow-up without directing means and methods.
Build a handover matrix for as-builts, O&M manuals, warranties, commissioning records, asset data, training and outstanding defects.
QA this BIM/asset handover for space/equipment IDs, document links, defects and post-occupancy actions without certifying commissioning.
Create a render brief with cameras, lighting, materials and staged QA for these architecture views, clearly separating exact geometry from illustrative entourage.
Plan an Enscape/Twinmotion/V-Ray/Blender visualization workflow that keeps the model revision and material truth visible through post-processing.
Audit this IFC exchange for schema, coordinates, GUIDs, spatial hierarchy, properties and IDS information requirements, then structure BCF issues.
Plan an IfcOpenShell/Bonsai federation and round-trip check across architecture/structure/MEP without treating a successful export as interoperability proof.
Audit this AutoCAD DWG for units, xrefs, layers, blocks, layouts, CTB/STB and plotting dependencies before a safe batch cleanup.
Plan an AutoLISP/.NET workflow to update selected title blocks and sheets using handles/counts, a dry run, new output paths and proof PDFs.
